candidates.name: South Lido Key Beach Park on the Gulf

evidence.source_name: Sarasota County Parks — Ted Sperling Park at South Lido Beach
supports: Sarasota County lists beach access, fishing, picnicking, a playground, restrooms, an unpaved trail, swimming, and wildlife viewing at Ted Sperling Park at South Lido Beach.
Sarasota County lists daily hours of 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. for Ted Sperling Park at South Lido Beach.
The county-listed restrooms, playground, fishing, picnic space, and unpaved trail support a longer park visit.
Visit Sarasota describes South Lido Park as a 100-acre park influenced by the Gulf of Mexico, Big Sarasota Pass, Sarasota Bay, and Brushy Bayou.
Visit Sarasota describes a Gulf beach, plus birdwatching and canoeing near Brushy Bayou.
South Lido offers a Gulf beach as well as separate paddling and birdwatching options near Brushy Bayou.

editorial.hook: A Gulf beach plus separate Brushy Bayou paddling and birdwatching, with restrooms and picnic space.
editorial.why_here: South Lido puts several kinds of water day in one park: a Gulf beach, plus canoeing and birdwatching near Brushy Bayou. The county-listed playground, restrooms, fishing, picnic space, and unpaved trail make it practical to stay beyond one beach stop.
editorial.know_before: Check posted conditions before entering the water; county amenities include restrooms and a playground.
editorial.best_time: The county lists 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. hours; leave time for both beach and bayou activities.
editorial.local_tip: Choose the Gulf beach for sand time or the Brushy Bayou area for paddling and birdwatching.

evidence.source_name: Destin-Fort Walton Beach — Henderson Beach State Park
supports: Destin-Fort Walton Beach describes Henderson Beach State Park as a 200-acre park with a winding nature trail through coastal scrub.
The destination page lists Gulf swimming, surf fishing, a mile-long paved road, and 60 campsites.
The destination page lists six picnic pavilions and a playground overlooking the Gulf of Mexico.
The destination page describes a three-quarter-mile pet-friendly trail through dunes and vegetation.
Henderson Beach combines Gulf shoreline time with a three-quarter-mile dune and vegetation trail.

editorial.hook: A Gulf beach backed by a three-quarter-mile dune trail, with six picnic pavilions and a playground.
editorial.why_here: Henderson Beach State Park adds a winding coastal-scrub trail to a Gulf beach day. The three-quarter-mile route passes through dunes and vegetation, while six picnic pavilions and a playground overlooking the Gulf of Mexico give families places to pause away from the shoreline.
editorial.know_before: The trail is listed as pet-friendly; confirm current park rules before taking pets beyond it.
editorial.best_time: Split the visit between Gulf shoreline time and the three-quarter-mile dune and vegetation trail.
editorial.local_tip: Bring a picnic for one of six pavilions; the playground overlooks the Gulf of Mexico.

evidence.source_name: City of Sanibel — Lighthouse Beach Park
supports: The City of Sanibel identifies the Sanibel Island Lighthouse as a cast-iron structure first lit in 1884 and says it is not open for public tours.
The city describes a Gulf-side beach for swimming, sunbathing, and shelling.
The city describes bay-side kayaking and paddleboarding, with a fishing pier that is closed until further notice.
The city lists nature trails and a boardwalk through mangroves and along the shoreline.
The city says Lighthouse Beach Park is open 24 hours a day year-round.
Lighthouse Beach Park sits at the eastern tip of Sanibel Island.

editorial.hook: A cast-iron 1884 lighthouse, Gulf-side shelling, and a mangrove boardwalk at Sanibel's eastern tip.
editorial.why_here: Lighthouse Beach Park pairs the Sanibel Island Lighthouse with two waterfront experiences: swimming and shelling on the Gulf side, then kayaking or paddleboarding on the bay side. Nature trails and a boardwalk through the mangroves add another change of pace from the sand.
editorial.know_before: The lighthouse is not open for tours, and the fishing pier is closed until further notice.
editorial.best_time: Allow daylight for the mangrove boardwalk; the beach park itself is open 24 hours.
editorial.local_tip: Choose the Gulf side for shelling or the bay side for kayaking and paddleboarding.

evidence.source_name: City of Sanibel — Bowman's Beach Park
supports: The City of Sanibel describes a quarter-mile walk from parking to the shoreline over a footbridge crossing Clam Bayou.
The city lists restrooms, changing rooms, outside showers, picnic areas, a playground, shade pavilions, a fitness trail, and a kayak launch.
The city says Bowman's Beach Park is open 24 hours a day year-round and uses a mobile parking payment app.
The city describes shelling, kayaking, and birdwatching at Bowman's Beach Park.
The city says recovery work is ongoing and cautions visitors about possible buried debris along the shoreline and in the water.
Bowman's Beach sits beyond a quarter-mile footbridge approach rather than directly beside the parking area.

editorial.hook: A quarter-mile footbridge approach over Clam Bayou, leading to shelling, trails, and a kayak launch.
editorial.why_here: Bowman's Beach starts before the sand, with a quarter-mile walk from parking and a footbridge over Clam Bayou. Beyond it, the park combines a shelling beach with a kayak launch, fitness trail, playground, picnic areas, changing rooms, and outside showers for a full-day setup away from the lot.
editorial.know_before: Recovery work is ongoing; the city warns that buried debris may remain along the shoreline and in the water.
editorial.best_time: Use daylight for the footbridge approach and shoreline; the park itself is open 24 hours.
editorial.local_tip: Plan for the quarter-mile walk from parking to sand, including the footbridge over Clam Bayou.
